description: This file implements the functionality for adding (following) a profile (user) within the Followers feature of the application. It contains a command definition, validation, and a handler that checks existing follow relationships and creates a new follow if none exists, then returns the profile data.

classes.name: Add
classes.description: Contains the command, validator, and handler classes for the 'Add follower' functionality.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the command to follow a user, including validation of users, creating follow relationship if it doesn't exist, and returning the profile.
